rows.label: A camera flash lights up smiles in a group hug.
The muffled sound of throwing up comes from behind some wall.
Strangers aplaud as someone in drag shows a few dance steps.
Long fluorescent lamps form geometrical shapes on the ceiling.
This night is amazing, says someone to their lover as they hold each other.
This night sucks, says a drunk girl in a torn pantyhose with two bloodied knees.
Pierced nipples bounce under a black see-through shirt.
Almost empty cups are grouped on a small table surrounded by laughter.
A phosphorescent painting on the wall stands out behind black sillouettes.
Pressed against each other, hips move in sync.
The friend of a dancing girl grabs her by her hand, and takes her somewhere.
A cool video game plushie watches the party from within the DJ booth.
Someone sticks out their tongue, and their friends place something on it.
Girls fix their hair in the mirror just outside the restroom.
Moving lights paint the darkness with colorful smiles.
Two people bump into each other, both spilling beer, both apologizing profusely.
Makeup runs down a sobbing girl’s face. All her friends gather around her, worried.
A credit card machine finally powers on, and people in the queue applaud.
A girl’s cheeks and chest sparkle with glitter.
A group of friends cheers in perfect sync, then immediately returns to their regular tone.
A cult TV show poster hangs among others on the wall.
A couple breaks a kiss so one of them can lick a third person’s powdered fingertip.
Security interrupts a horny couple making out on a couch.
Someone takes a puff without looking away from their phone. They're playing chess.
A sweaty girl impatiently waits for her drink, the blue of her eyes almost completely black.
A girl dances alone, eyes closed, lost in the rhythm.
A couple kisses slowly against a wall, lost in their own little world.
Friends cheer as a man takes a shot, salt and lemon waiting on the counter.
Changing lights color a scissors tattoo on a shoulder.
A bartender respectfully but firmly cuts off a chatty drunk man.
Muscular legs cast a curvy, dancing shadow.
A couple stares at each other in silence, his arms around her back, her hand inside his pants.
A herbal-scented smoke drifts in from somewhere.
Ew, it’s full of old people, a teenager says to her friends, eyes fixed on a group of thirty-somethings.
A girl turns from the bar, stops, and smiles with her eyes, welcoming a kiss from a stranger.
A man rambles at a woman whose eyes refuse to meet his.
A smiling man hugs a friend from behind and kisses his neck.
A trembling girl in a short dress complains about the cold.
As a new song starts, friends look at each other and run to the dance floor.
Three people kiss each other, drawing annoyed looks for blocking the way to the restroom.
A nervous girl avoids eye contact with her friend, afraid to make the first move.
A dancer raises their arms to the ceiling as if in prayer.
An open shirt reveals numbers tattooed on a collarbone.
A girl screams with joy as her friend lifts her into a hug.
Two smiling girls align their faces, and a mint goes from one tongue to the other.
A man stands alone in a corner, high as a kite. Someone asks for a lighter, and he lends it.
A bartender stutters while taking the order of someone she’d been checking out.
Eat her out if you really love her, says a Barbie paste-up on the wall.
Friends pet the head of a polite dog that somehow got in, its tail wagging.
Balloons are thrown around. When the lights change colors, so do they.
